skill.name: ubs
skill.description: UBS is a static analysis workflow guide for running the Ultimate Bug Scanner before commits, pull requests, and CI releases.
skill.summary: Run UBS as a pre-commit and CI quality gate for AI-assisted code changes.
skill.author: Dicklesworthstone

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown tables, code fences, and inline examples. The install guidance still includes a real curl-to-bash command and a remote executable download into /usr/local/bin. The skill also describes persistent agent hook configuration, so it is not suitable for automatic marketplace installation without review.

remediation.suggestion: Replace the curl-to-bash command with signed releases, pinned versions, checksums, and a manual inspection step.
Avoid writing remote downloads directly to system paths. Prefer user-local installation with checksum verification.
Require explicit opt-in for each agent integration, document every file changed, and provide a complete uninstall path.

static_findings.snippet: | **JavaScript/TypeScript** | innerHTML XSS, eval(), missing await, React hooks deps |
| **Python** | eval(), open() without with, missing encoding=, None checks |
Parse: `file:line:col` → location | `💡` → how to fix | Exit 0/1 → pass/fail
| **Type Coercion** | `==` vs `===`, `parseInt` without radix, NaN comparison |
10,000+ lines per second. Use `--jobs=N` to control parallelism.
| Fix symptom (`if (x) { x.y }`) | Fix root cause (`x?.y`) |
| "ast-grep not found" | `brew install ast-grep` or `cargo install ast-grep` |
| Too many false positives | Use `--skip=N` or `// ubs:ignore` |
| Slow scans | Scope to files: `ubs <file>` not `ubs .` |

content.user_title: Scan Code for Bugs Before Commit
content.value_statement: AI-assisted changes can introduce null safety, async, security, and resource bugs before review. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code a concise workflow for running UBS as a quality gate.
actual_capabilities: Explains how to scan changed files, staged files, full projects, and CI jobs with UBS.
Documents UBS output formats, including text, JSON, JSONL, SARIF, and HTML reports.
Lists detection categories for null safety, security, async issues, memory leaks, and type coercion.
Shows workflows for baselines, comparison reports, inline suppressions, and custom AST rules.
Describes integrations for Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, Gemini, Windsurf, Cline, and related tools.
limitations: The marketplace package contains documentation only, not the UBS scanner implementation.
Installation depends on remote GitHub downloads that must be reviewed before execution.
Static analysis findings can include false positives and still require human judgment.
Custom rules and agent hooks require local configuration outside this skill file.

use_cases.title: Pre-Commit Review
use_cases.description: Run UBS on staged or changed files before committing AI-assisted code.

use_cases.title: CI Quality Gate
use_cases.description: Add strict UBS scans and machine-readable reports to pull request pipelines.

use_cases.title: Agent Workflow Guardrails
use_cases.description: Give coding agents a repeatable scan, fix, and re-run loop before handoff.
use_cases.target_user: Engineering teams using Claude Code or Codex

prompt_templates.title: Scan Changed Files
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner workflow for a local change set.
prompt_templates.prompt: Run UBS on my changed files and summarize blocking issues, likely causes, and the safest next fixes.

prompt_templates.title: Triage Findings
prompt_templates.scenario: Review UBS output after a scan.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these UBS findings, separate confirmed bugs from likely false positives, and explain each decision briefly.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare CI Gate
prompt_templates.scenario: Create a strict pull request scan workflow.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a UBS CI quality gate for this repository, including failure rules, report formats, and rollout steps.

prompt_templates.title: Build Custom Rules
prompt_templates.prompt: Propose custom UBS AST rules for our recurring bug patterns and explain how to validate them safely.

output_examples.input: Ask the agent to scan staged files before commit.
output_examples.output: The agent reports critical findings first, identifies affected files, and recommends the smallest safe fixes.
The response outlines strict scan mode, report artifacts, pull request annotations, and a baseline comparison strategy.
The response names candidate patterns, affected languages, validation checks, and suppression guidance for intentional exceptions.

best_practices: Run UBS on changed files first, then broaden scope before release or merge.
Review every high severity finding before suppressing it.
Pin installer sources and verify checksums before adding UBS to shared environments.
anti_patterns: Do not pipe remote installer scripts directly into a shell without review.
Do not suppress UBS findings until the underlying code path is understood.
Do not let automated hooks change agent behavior without explicit team approval.

faq.question: What does this skill help me do?
faq.answer: It guides AI agents through UBS scans, triage, fixes, and CI usage for code quality checks.

faq.question: Does this skill include the UBS scanner?
faq.answer: No. The skill file documents UBS workflows and installation commands for an external project.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: It declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.

faq.question: Can UBS replace code review?
faq.answer: No. UBS can surface likely issues, but engineers must still review findings and code behavior.

faq.question: Is automatic installation recommended?
faq.answer: No. The installation guidance uses remote downloads, so users should inspect and verify sources first.

faq.question: Can teams customize checks?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill describes custom AST rules and exclusions for project-specific policies.
